findings.evidence: `Reverse.lean:69` has `revFiltration_apply ... : (revFiltration 𝔽 h_antitone h_le N) n = 𝔽 (N - n)`, while `TailReverseFiltration.lean:35-36` only rewrites `tailProcess_eq_iInf_tailFamily` and simplifies `revFiltration_apply, tsub_zero` for `tailFamily X`.
findings.fix: Add a generic theorem in `TauCeti/Probability/Martingale/Reverse.lean`, e.g. `iInf_revFiltration_zero (𝔽) (h_antitone) (h_le) : (⨅ N, (revFiltration 𝔽 h_antitone h_le N : Filtration ℕ m0) 0) = ⨅ N, 𝔽 N`, then derive the process theorem from it and `tailProcess_eq_iInf_tailFamily`.
findings.issue: `tailProcess_eq_iInf_revFiltration` proves the special process case directly, but the substantive fact is generic: the infimum of the zero levels of `revFiltration 𝔽 ... N` is `⨅ N, 𝔽 N`.

summary: The process-tail theorem is stated only as a special-case rewrite of a generic reverse-filtration fact, so the API is below the natural Mathlib/TauCeti level for this adapter.
